source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Leader (February 2019)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Team Leader for the **WCA Marketing Team (WMT)**, which has been led by the WCA Board since its creation. The WMT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.
<!-- break -->
Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Marketing background
- Social media knowledge
- Fluent English
- Excellent communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **February 28th, 2019, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
- Brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done for the WCA
- Ambitions as the WMT Leader

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WMT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).

Following the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组负责人招募（2019 年 2 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将为**市场营销组（WMT）**任命新的负责人。该团队自成立以来一直由 WCA 董事会领导。WMT 是 WCA 的咨询委员会，负责建立和管理 WCA 品牌、寻求赞助、协助发放 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理团队工作，并具备以下条件：

- 市场营销背景
- 了解社交媒体
- 英语流利
- 出色的沟通能力

请在 **2019 年 2 月 28 日 23:59 UTC** 前，将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 简短的个人介绍
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
- 担任 WMT 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WMT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

提前感谢各位申请和支持！
notes: 原文将 WMT 称为 Advisory Committee，按原文保留咨询委员会表述。
